gen-gf-warnes-fs-roundo: Roundo keeps its lowercase modest and its counters open. Warnes towers over it with stretched, spacious tracking and tapering ink strokes, so a body size a notch or two below the heading feels about right.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-spline-sans: Big, stretched and unshaded, Warnes lets its strokes taper off before they touch, while Spline Sans holds back with wide gaps between curve ends and stems. Paragraphs in it feel approachable.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-synonym: Warnes stretches out wide and bold, every stroke tapering away. Its strongest quality is that ruler-straight, unshaded line, which gives Synonym's sans text, a plain stripe of constant ink, something loud to stand against.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-aclonica: Aclonica has a deep midsection and a long, widely spaced line. Warnes does its best work with a ruler-straight stroke and bold tapering ends, while Aclonica does its best with mild contrast you feel more than see.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-allerta: Tapering ink strokes with no shading anywhere give Warnes its stretched, spacious bold voice. And Allerta, with its prominent x-height and loose tracking, carries a longer paragraph in a steady, unfussy way.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-alumni-sans: Alumni Sans has ascenders that barely clear the x-height and a wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart, with understated thick-thin contrast. Warnes brings tubelike, constant-weight lines above it, and the mild stress below keeps each stroke solid.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Approachable and tight-textured, Alumni Sans Pinstripe sets oversized lowercase letters beside small capitals, with curves as hefty as a rope's body. Warnes above it is expressive and stretched out, tapering every stroke.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Warnes builds its uppercase from lines of one constant thickness, stretched wide and tapering at the ends. Alumni Sans SC reads tighter, its oversized lowercase and slightly heavier stems giving a longer passage subtle, visible modulation.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anaheim: Loud, round and wide, Warnes gives its curves walls as heavy as its straight lines. But Anaheim packs its modern, open-sided forms into a dense huddle that the eye slides through.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-arsenal: Plain ink, no swell, stretched wide: that is Warnes, with strokes that taper out before they touch. And Arsenal does the opposite best, a close-knit line with a lightly tilted nib's soft variation and a tall x-height.
